messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened PR #4825 (migration guide + SDK snippets) that patches the Private deployment page and adds a Python example. Docs preview failed with link-check errors. Can people review for terminology/tone and link sanity?
ryan: pinging @ana and @josh for reviews. Is the preview URL working?
docs-bot: Docs preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4825 — Link-check: 2 broken links, 1 lint warning.
nana: I can take a pass on the tone/terminology later today. Which terms are in flux?
nana: (typo) meant @ana — sorry
ana: From a quick skim: uses "private deployment" and "private" inconsistently. We should standardize on "Redwood Private" per style guide. Also avoid "our users" — prefer "you" or "customers".
josh: On the SDK example: the Python snippet still uses old client instantiation. Recommend: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.chat.create(model="redwood-1", input="Hi")
```
josh: Also remove the hard-coded region in the snippet; use config example instead.
sam: Link failures look like relative path to ../sdk/python in the migration section; on netlify preview that turned into a 404. Will patch to absolute /docs/sdk/python or use rst :ref: style.
maria: Good catches. I pushed a small commit to fix the Python snippet and updated references to "Redwood Private". Still need to address the two broken links.
docs-bot: CI Docs Link Check output:
```
ERROR: Broken link: /docs/sdk/python -> 404
ERROR: Broken link: /docs/private/old-migration -> 404
WARNING: line-length: docs/private/migration.md:120
```
ryan: @sam can you push the relative-link fix and re-run preview? If you can't, I can add a quick redirect in the nav as a stopgap.
sam: Pushing fix now. Also adjusting voice: change passive voice in the intro paragraphs to active — makes it more actionable for readers.
nana: Quick style nit: examples should use second person when describing steps ("You can..."), and API names inline code-style (``redwood.Client``). Also prefer present tense.
maria: Thanks — I applied the voice edits and updated API inline code formatting. New preview should appear in ~5m.
docs-bot: New preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4825/2 — Link-check: 0 broken links, 0 warnings.
josh: LGTM for the SDK snippet now. One small suggestion: add a streaming example (two lines) or link to the streaming guide.
ryan: We'll wait for at least 2 approvals and CI green before merging. @ana, once you approve, can you add the label `ready/merge`?
ana: Approved. Adding label `ready/merge`. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all. I'll wait for Josh's approval and then schedule merge during the docs merge window tomorrow morning to avoid CI backlog.
josh: Approved. Added a short note to the PR describing the snippet change and migration steps.
maria: Merged during the morning window — thanks everyone for quick reviews. :party:
